gaps.why_now: The roadmap gap is still sample-side, so the narrowest honest progress is a manifest-backed survey packet that records the current owner, rollback owner, C-anchor replay, and C-anchor-only lab posture without pretending the Zig sample already exists.
A dedicated Phase 4 survey gate keeps the current kprobe roadmap row measurable inside the shared Phase 4 build instead of leaving the row as prose-only matrix guidance.

The live replay still stays on the C anchor through `make M=samples/kprobes CONFIG_SAMPLE_KPROBES=m`, so the survey packet has to keep that exact command explicit while the Zig lab matrix remains C-anchor-only.

The shared build already runs `phase4-kprobe-example-survey-tests`, but the survey packet still lacks a dedicated `make -C zigux phase4-kprobe-example-survey` wrapper and shared-validator promotion, so the next bounded same-lane step is to publish that local replay path before claiming parity with the neighboring survey gates.

The actual Zig sample is still absent on `master`, so the next bounded step after the survey wrapper work is a starter under `samples/zigux/` that keeps the same owner, rollback owner, and `make M=samples/kprobes CONFIG_SAMPLE_KPROBES=m` replay contract instead of widening into broader probe registration behavior.
